candidates.name: OGC Web Processing Service
verified_facts: OGC Web Processing Service standardizes requests and responses for publishing, discovering and executing geospatial processes and handling their outputs.
WPS can accept data over a network or operate on data available at the server.
semantic_limits: Availability or successful execution of a process does not certify the accuracy of its input data, algorithm assumptions, output uncertainty or parcel-specific suitability.

candidates.name: OGC Coordinate Transformation Standard
verified_facts: The OGC Coordinate Transformation Standard specifies a way for software to access coordinate transformation services for spatial data.
Its purpose includes allowing data from different sources to be represented relative to a common spatial reference system.
semantic_limits: Transformation-service capability does not prove that the required current grid/model/version was actually applied or that the resulting horizontal and vertical error budget is acceptable.
